$comment: Mirror of docs/questionnaire.schema.json — keep in sync when the schema changes.
title: umfrage Questionnaire Configuration
description: Schema for questionnaire YAML files used with the umfrage CLI tool. Add '# yaml-language-server: $schema=../docs/questionnaire.schema.json' at the top of your YAML file to enable IDE validation and autocomplete.

title.description: Human-readable title of the questionnaire (used in Excel headers and as the basis for the file name slug).

version.description: Version string for the questionnaire. Increment when making changes that would invalidate existing responses.

language.description: Language code for all static UI labels in the generated Excel file (column headers, yes/no dropdown values, hints, etc.). Must match a YAML file in umfrage/i18n/. Built-in codes: 'en' (English), 'de' (German). Add umfrage/i18n/<code>.yaml to register a new language.

choice_lists.description: Named reusable choice lists. Keys are arbitrary identifiers; values are the list of option strings. Reference a list in any choices-type question with 'choices_ref: <name>'. At least 2 options per list. The comma-joined options must not exceed 255 characters (Excel DV formula limit).

organizer.description: Information about the person or institution conducting the questionnaire.

institution.description: Name of the organizer's institution or organization.

email.description: Contact email address of the organizer.

respondent_fields.description: Metadata fields that each respondent must fill in. Typical fields: Name, Institution, Email.

label.description: Display label shown next to the input field in the Excel file.

required.description: Whether this field must be filled in. Empty required fields cause validation failure during collection.

sections.description: Ordered list of sections (chapters) in the questionnaire. Each section groups related questions.

title.description: Section title shown as a colored header row in the Excel file.

questions.description: Ordered list of questions in this section.

id.description: Unique question identifier. Slug-safe: letters, digits, dots, hyphens, underscores. Must start and end with a letter or digit. Examples: 'S1.Q1', 'general.q01', 'tech-2'.

text.description: The full question text displayed to respondents in the Excel file.

answer.description: Configuration for the expected answer type and constraints.

type.description: Answer type. 'scale': integer in [min_value, max_value]; 'yes_no': exactly 'Yes' or 'No'; 'freetext': any non-empty string; 'choices': one of a fixed set of options shown as a dropdown.

min_value.description: Required for 'scale' type. Inclusive lower bound. Must be strictly less than max_value.

max_value.description: Required for 'scale' type. Inclusive upper bound. Must be strictly greater than min_value.

description.description: Optional hint text shown in the Scale/Comment column.

choices.description: Inline option list for 'choices' type. Provide either this or choices_ref, not both. At least 2 items required. The comma-joined string must not exceed 255 characters.

choices_ref.description: Name of a list defined in the top-level choice_lists dict. Provide either this or choices, not both.

show_choices_in_comment.description: CHOICES type only. When false, the auto-generated option list is not shown in the Scale/Comment column — useful when the list is long and would make the column too wide. The description field is still shown instead. Has no effect when a 'comment' is also set on the question, because an explicit comment is a complete override for all types (identical behaviour to scale, yes_no, and freetext).

comment.description: Additional context shown in the Scale/Comment column. Overrides any auto-generated hint (scale range, choices list, etc.).

required.description: Whether an answer is mandatory. Empty required answers fail validation during collection.
